title: 学校的旅行
text: 一张地图放在桌子上。我们班的学生准备去北京。大家都很兴奋，因为这是第一次集体旅行。我们坐火车去，路上的风景非常漂亮。窗外的山越来越高，云也越来越近。我坐在朋友旁边，我们聊了很多有趣的事情。到了以后，我们先去了长城。虽然路很长，但我觉得很有意思。老师告诉我们，这里有很多历史故事。我们拍了很多照片，想把这些记忆留下来。旅行的时间过得很快。我想，学习历史最好的办法就是亲自去看。这次旅行让我明白了，世界比书本大得多。我希望明年还能和同学们一起出去玩。

patterns.title: 越…越…
patterns.explanation: "The more X, the more Y." Pairs two qualities or actions that increase together. The collocation 越来越 (increasingly) is the same structure.
patterns.example_translation: The weather is getting colder and colder.

patterns.title: 了 — completed action
patterns.explanation: Marks an action as completed (post-verbal 了) or a change of state (sentence-final 了). Worth re-reading whenever you spot it — the position shifts the meaning.

patterns.title: 把 disposal
patterns.explanation: Moves the object in front of the verb to emphasise what was done to it. Often translated as "take X and …" — "I took the book and read it."
